name: Vadocondes (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a blue wavy stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Vadocondes (a crozier on red above a bridge and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Vadocondes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Vadocondes arms — crozier above a bridge and waves
